answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 4 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in kernel, checked in ridge, and wharf shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1908 identities would post 3389 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
